verdict.rationale: Floot projects include backend endpoints (docs-33) and scheduled jobs (docs-20). Integrations are built by describing them to the assistant, which generates the endpoints, tables and screens (docs-26), with API keys entered through a secure dialog (docs-27). Email is built in for both sending and receiving, with a send log (docs-13, docs-19). Missing for 10: no explicit evidence of a payments integration such as Stripe, no detail on how server-side functions are written or configured, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
